visual.detailed_description: Panel A (top) pairs an axial upper-chest slice with a coronal chest reconstruction, carrying viewer overlays (date stamps 2/24/2025, series/image numbers, window settings, a trial-license banner) and green asterisk, red arrow, blue arrow, green arrowhead and blue arrowhead markers. panels.general_description: Two stacked grayscale CT images from a viewer: an axial upper-chest slice above a coronal chest reconstruction, annotated with colored arrow, asterisk and arrowhead markers.
panels.detailed_description: Top: axial mediastinal-window chest slice with a blue letter "A" at upper left, orientation letters R (left edge) and L (right edge) and a small "A" at top centre. A green asterisk lies over a rounded soft-tissue structure on the viewer-left (R-labelled) side of the anterior mediastinum; a red arrow points to a round structure on the viewer-right (L-labelled) anterior side; a blue arrow points to a round structure beside the vertebral body on the viewer-left (R-labelled) posterior side. Viewer overlay text reads "2/24/2025 12:27:00 PM - MidIASTINAL VOL", "Im: 174/444", "Se: 4", "X: 141 Y: 288 Val: 32" (partly obscured), "WL: 50 WW: 350 [D]", "T: 1.3mm L: -140.6mm", "200mA 120kV", "2/24/2025 12:27:01 PM" and masked "***" fields. A dark-red banner reads "You have 26 days left in your trial period. Purchase a license at https://radiantviewer.com/store/". Bottom: coronal reconstruction ("2/24/2025 12:27:09 PM - MidIASTINAL VOL", "Im: 211/512", "Se: 4", R left, L right, S at top) showing both lungs and a rounded soft-tissue structure in the lower mid-chest above the diaphragm; a green arrowhead touches its viewer-left (R-labelled) lower border and a blue arrowhead on the viewer-right (L-labelled) side lies near the left diaphragmatic dome. The lower edge of the image is cut by the same banner.

pixel_observations: Axial slice (top): green asterisk on a rounded anterior-mediastinal structure on the viewer-left (R-labelled) side; red arrow on a round anterior structure on the viewer-right (L-labelled) side; blue arrow on a round structure beside the vertebral body on the viewer-left (R-labelled) posterior side.

Coronal reconstruction (bottom): green arrowhead at the viewer-left (R-labelled) lower border of a rounded soft-tissue structure in the lower mid-chest; blue arrowhead on the viewer-right (L-labelled) side near the diaphragmatic dome.
Orientation letters R (viewer-left) and L (viewer-right) are printed on both images, so patient right is displayed on the viewer-left.

Burned-in overlay stamps read "2/24/2025 12:27:00 PM", "2/24/2025 12:27:01 PM" (axial) and "2/24/2025 12:27:09 PM" (coronal); series "Se: 4", images "Im: 174/444" and "Im: 211/512", "WL: 50 WW: 350 [D]", "200mA 120kV", "T: 1.3mm".
Several overlay fields are masked as "***" strings and carry no legible text.

A trial-viewer banner ("You have 26 days left in your trial period. Purchase a license at https://radiantviewer.com/store/") overlies the lower part of the axial image and the bottom edge of the coronal image.
Vessel and chamber densities look similar to adjacent soft tissue, with no distinct bright intravascular contrast visible at this resolution.

panels.general_description: Two grayscale CT images side by side: an axial upper-abdominal slice (left) and a coronal chest and upper-abdomen reconstruction (right), with red, blue and green arrowheads.
panels.detailed_description: A light-blue letter "B" sits at upper left. Left: axial slice at the level of the lower thorax/upper abdomen with R at the left edge and L at the right edge; a large homogeneous organ occupies the anterior and viewer-right (L-labelled) abdomen, and a green arrowhead points to its viewer-right portion. A red arrowhead points to a posterior organ on the viewer-left (R-labelled) side, and a blue arrowhead on the viewer-left of midline points into a region of heterogeneous low-density content near the central abdomen. A round vertebral body is at bottom centre with a round structure just anterior to it; the CT table line curves along the bottom. Right: coronal reconstruction showing both lungs, the mediastinum and the spine (R left, L right); a red arrowhead points to a soft-tissue organ under the viewer-left (R-labelled) diaphragm and a green arrowhead points to a dome-shaped organ under the viewer-right (L-labelled) diaphragm. A grey vertical divider with a small handle icon separates the two images. No scan-metadata overlay or timestamp is legible in panel B.
